title: VIEW-006: split and tile panes in the GUI
acceptance: the bottom bar exposes a Split view picker for single pane, side by side and stacked; the canvas paints the active tab twice with independent scroll offsets and a real divider; a widget test drives the picker; VIEW-006 becomes verified on the gui host.
notes: ADR 0009 row 8. The split geometry model existed; the GUI had no control and the canvas painted one pane.
